title: Uber launches Uber Parking, an in-app parking reservation tool powered by its SpotHero acquisition, in 15 US cities, including Chicago, NYC, and San Francisco (Andrew J. Hawkins/The Verge)
summary: Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge: Uber launches Uber Parking, an in-app parking reservation tool powered by its SpotHero acquisition, in 15 US cities, including Chicago, NYC, and San Francisco — Powered by its SpotHero acquisition, Uber's new parking reservation tool is a play for commuter loyalty — and a staging ground for its robotaxi future.
